title: NICE head-injury pathway
subtitle: CT and observation criteria
summary: This is a branching CT and observation pathway rather than a summed score. It requires exact age-specific NICE criteria and local conveyance policy.
population: Age-specific history, examination, anticoagulant/antiplatelet status, loss of consciousness or amnesia, neurological findings, vomiting, seizure and mechanism.
exclusions: Do not enter assumed normal results.
overrides: Follow the applicable NICE, local emergency department or specialty pathway.
limitations: This is a branching CT and observation pathway rather than a summed score. It requires exact age-specific NICE criteria and local conveyance policy.
